description: For any propositional formulas \(A\) and \(B\), the singleton premise \(A\) entails \(B\) if and only if \(A\to B\) is a tautology.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.entails_singleton_iff_tautology.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Entails {A} B ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Tautology (A.impl B)
